items.rationale: Clauses 2.3.3, 4.2.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like replacement of the damaged system, but not undamaged components replaced for matching. The estimated €280 gross and the TV estimate are together below the €5,000 event cap; no missing surge protection is established and no deductible amount is stated.
Clauses 7.1.8(b) and 5.2.2 exclude delivery of replacement equipment, even when the supplier bills it alongside covered equipment. No amount is payable.
Clause 7.1.8(c) excludes installing and putting replacement equipment into service. The billed hour is not payable.

Clauses 2.3.3, 4.2.4 and 7.1.9 cover a TV of equivalent pre-loss specification; €565 gross is consistent with Case 9. The shared €5,000 cap does not bind, and there is no established basis for the 50% surge-protection reduction.
Clauses 3.1.4 and 7.1.8(f) exclude the whole combined charge because no physical-damage element is separately itemised and priced. No amount is payable.
Clauses 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude the charge for placing an order under the service arrangement. No amount is payable.
Clause 7.1.8(d) covers attendance only when the same invoice includes indemnifiable work. Neither of the other building-services lines qualifies, so no vehicle costs are payable.
